rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for confidence in or reliance on a person.

example.english: I really trust you, so I can discuss anything with you.
example.traditional: 我好信任你，有咩事都可以同你商量。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 seon3 jam6 nei5 jau5 me1 si6 dou1 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 soeng1 loeng4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for trusting or relying on a person.

example.english: I trust you, so I’ll leave this matter to you.
example.traditional: 我信得過你，呢件事交畀你做。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seon3 dak1 gwo3 nei5 ni1 gin6 si6 gaau1 bei2 nei5 zou6

rows.note: Choose this more formal word for placing general confidence in a person rather than the casual 信得過.

example.english: I trust your ability to handle this project.
example.traditional: 我信任你處理呢個項目嘅能力。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seon3 jam6 nei5 cyu2 lei5 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 nang4 lik6

rows.note: Use this when expressing confidence that a proposition or situation is true.

example.english: I trust that he’ll come back tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 ting1 jat6 wui5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this for creditworthiness or confidence that payment will be made, rather than personal emotional trust.

example.english: This company has good credit, so I trust them to pay for the goods later.
example.traditional: 呢間公司信用好，我放心賒貨畀佢哋。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 seon3 jung6 hou2 ngo5 fong3 sam1 se1 fo3 bei2 keoi5 dei6

rows.note: Use this construction when entrusting a thing, task, or responsibility from A to B.

example.english: We trust Ming with organizing the event.
example.traditional: 我哋將個活動交畀阿明負責。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 go3 wut6 dung6 gaau1 bei2 aa3 ming4 fu6 zaak3

rows.note: Use this formal legal term for property held and managed for another person's benefit.

example.english: A trust has been set up for this inheritance, with a trustee managing it for the beneficiary.
example.traditional: 呢筆遺產已經設立信託，由受託人代受益人管理。
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 wai4 caan2 ji5 ging1 cit3 lap6 seon3 tok3 jau4 sau6 tok3 jan4 doi6 sau6 jik1 jan4 gun2 lei5
